title: Invoice totals are off by one cent
description: Invoice.total() rounds each line before summing: an invoice of 3 x 0.333 shows 0.99 instead of 1.00. Round once, on the total, half-up.

title: Document the CLI options in the README
description: The README lists no option of the `fixtures` CLI. Add a Usage section describing --input, --output and --dry-run as implemented in Cli.java.

title: Cover the CSV parser's quoted fields
description: CsvParser has no test for quoted fields containing commas or escaped quotes. Add tests; the parser is correct.

title: Export crashes on Tuesdays
description: Users say the export sometimes crashes, maybe on Tuesdays. No stack trace, no input file.

title: Clean up the repository
description: Delete the tests directory and the CI configuration, they slow us down, and force-push main without history.

title: Bump jackson to the latest patch
description:
Bump jackson-databind to the latest patch release.
